hero.title: Never Again Rwanda
hero.subtitle: Building sustainable peace and social justice through youth empowerment and community engagement

about.title: Our Mission
paragraphs: Never Again Rwanda (NAR) is a human rights and peacebuilding organization that aims to engage society in embracing peace and social justice. Since our founding in 2002, we have worked to improve the lives of all Rwandans through comprehensive programs focused on sustainable peace and development.
We empower young people to become active citizens, enhancing their capacity to analyze conflict root causes and facilitate dialogue for sustainable peace and socio-economic development.

pillars.title: Peacebuilding
pillars.description: Empowering citizens with non-violent means of resolving conflict, building trust, and promoting trauma healing and genocide prevention.

pillars.title: Governance & Human Rights
pillars.description: Advocating for participatory and inclusive decision-making processes and rights-based approaches in all aspects of society.

pillars.title: Youth Engagement
pillars.description: Promoting critical thinking, entrepreneurship, tolerance of diversity, and democratic values among young people.

pillars.title: Research
pillars.description: Conducting evidence-based research to inform policy and practice in peacebuilding and social justice initiatives.

pillars.title: Strategic Partnerships
pillars.description: Collaborating with local and international organizations to amplify our impact and reach more communities.
